text:
mira: quick RFC follow-up idea: introduce a "floating chunk lease" so loaders can claim transient read ownership of byte ranges without changing shard ownership. sketch below, please react. :thinking:

sam: can you outline the exact pain this solves? sounds like extra metadata + runtime checks.

mira: two pain points: (1) long-held shard ownership blocks eviction during slow network/warmup, leading to memory pressure; (2) progressive hotpatching needs multiple loaders to stream overlapping ranges safely. leases let us gate eviction by active readers instead of by owner.

jonathan: compatibility question: safetensors often uses contiguous offsets that change across minor rebuilds. how do leases stay valid across bundle version changes?

mira: leases are bound to the bundle id + version + chunk logical id (either content hash or chunk index) and a nonce. server signs the lease token. when a loader sees VERSION mismatch it must re-resolve the manifest and optionally retry with redirected chunk id.

kevin: eviction race: loader A holds read lease for 0..512KB, loader B starts streaming 256..768KB. eviction wants to free overlap. who wins?

mira: policy: lease has levels: read (non-blocking for pin), read-block (prevents eviction for TTL), and pin (explicit non-evictable until release). eviction examines the highest held level over any intersecting ranges and only evicts if all leases are below threshold or expired. this supports fast warmup without permanent pins.

sam: runtime overhead worries: we can't do signature verification per token. what's the hot path cost?

mira: validation happens at chunk boundaries. loaders obtain a signed token once and attach it to chunk-stream rpc. token verification is cached per loader process; heartbeats are async. per-token overhead is unchanged.

jonathan: multi-format bundles (mixing safetensors, raw bin, compressed slices) must be supported. do we need format-specific lease semantics?

mira: keep lease orthogonal. manifest contains chunk metadata: format, verifier (hash), byte-range mapping. lease only references chunk-id; loader uses manifest to interpret chunk contents and verify integrity.

kevin: observability: we need metrics for churn and conflicts so SRE can find pathological models.

mira: add metrics: leases_acquired, leases_released, lease_conflicts, avg_lease_ttl, lease_renewals_per_min. devops-bot: can you wire alerts for lease_conflicts > 100/min on a single model?

devops-bot: noted. will add a rule and dashboard tile for heatmap per-bundle.

sam: error semantics: define clear error codes so callers can fallback cleanly.

mira: propose errors: LEASE_EXPIRED (retry/resync), LEASE_DENIED (permission/deny), LEASE_VERSION_MISMATCH (manifest changed -> resolve), LEASE_CONFLICT (transient, retry backoff). callers map these to retry/resync/raise.

jonathan: rollout plan? feature flags? backwards compatibility with older loaders?

mira: rollout: implement coordinator behind a flag. loaders accept leases optionally. Start canary for low-traffic infra models for 2 weeks, collect metrics, then enable for selected dedicated clusters. Backward loaders skip lease flow (default to shard-owner semantics).

kevin: small nit: avoid adding anything to on-disk safetensors layout. we should not alter formats.

mira: agreed. no on-disk changes. chunk-id is logical; manifest maps it to format-specific offsets and verifiers.

sam: can you paste a minimal API sketch for the coordinator?

mira: sure, quick sketch:
```yaml
POST /v1/lease/acquire
body:
  bundle_id: "model-x:2026-02-01"
  chunk_id: "chunk-42" # logical id
  mode: "read" # read | read-block | pin
  ttl: 30
  requester: "loader-12"
response:
  200 OK
  lease_token: "<signed-token>"
  expires_at: 1769010029
  lease_level: "read-block"
```
```yaml
POST /v1/lease/heartbeat
body:
  lease_token: "<signed-token>"
response: 200 OK
```

kevin: ok. make sure token format is compact and includes signer/nonce/version so offline verification inside loader is cheap.

mira: yes, use compact JWT-like token with ed25519 sig. loader caches verification key per-bundle registry entry.

sam: lgtm. please add this thread as a short follow-up doc in the RFC and tag eng-platform + infra for review. :thumbsup:

mira: will write doc + test plan tomorrow and drop in the RFC thread. thanks! :rocket:
